D1_ACTIVITY.justification: Justification | This table records information about Field Activities. It is useful for Clients as it allows them to easily access and extract FA-related data via reports.

D1_SP.justification: Justification | This table records information about Field Activities. It is useful for Clients as it allows them to easily access and extract FA-related data via reports.

D1_DVC.justification: Justification: | This table records information about a Device. It is useful for Clients as it allows them to view information of existing Device in C2M. Where they're located or if they're installed at a Service Point. | Domain -> Device

D1_INSTALL_EVT.justification: The Install Event records the history of the device that has been installed or removed at a Service Point. It is useful for Clients as it allows them to easily fetch the list of Service Points and the related device history

CI_PREM.justification: Justification: This domain will retrieve Premise Information, Service Point Information as well as the related Account and Bill Cycle

D1_MSRMT.justification: Justification: | Device configurations represent specific configurations of a device as of a certain time. During the life of a device it can have different configuration (effective-dated). A device configuration can have one or more measuring component associated with it. It is useful for Clients as it allows them to easily access and extract the information. These includes Install Event and Measuring Component and Device.

D1_MEASR_COMP.justification: Justification | Measuring components are single points for which data will be received and stored in the system. Measuring components can be associated to a device or not (these are virtual or stand-alone). This is helpful for the Clients as it allows them to retrieve the Measuring Components that's either related to a SP or not used.

fields.name: MOST_RECENT_NON_EST_MSRMT_DTTM
fields.description: Most Recent Non Estimated Read Date/Time

D1_DVC_EVT.justification: Justification | Device events are developments that have taken place relative to a device, and can include power outages, power restorations, tampering alerts, command completions, among others.

D1_INIT_MSRMT_DATA.justification: Justification | Initial measurement data (IMD) is the term for measurement data in its initial (or raw) form. This is received from an external system or user created or system estimated in C2M. Once it's processed it will be stored as measurement(D1_MSRMT) or the IMD will be in Exception state depending on the VEE Rules setup. It is useful for Clients as it allows them to review the information of the expected number of reads uploaded to the system and how many are processed at a given period o

D1_USAGE.justification: Justification | Usage Transactions are records of bill determinant calculations for a Usage Subscription. This is useful to the Client as it allows them to retrieve the Bill information to the usage and measurement

CI_PER.justification: Justification: This domain will retrieve Person Information. At the very least, it matches the schema on datavergence. It should also be able to account for additional data entry in the future.

fields.name: WEB_PASSWD_ANS
fields.description: Web Self Service Password Hint Answer

C1_REPRESENTATIVE.justification: Justification | This will be used for the creation of Crew Based domain to measure Field Worker Performance (How many FAs can a crew complete within the Day)

CI_ADJ_STG_CTL.designer_notes: Agree, this is transitory/internal transaction. This can be skipped

CI_ADJ_STG_UP.designer_notes: Agree, this is transitory/internal transaction. This can be skipped

CI_APPR_REQ.designer_notes: Agree, a domain should be created as this table contains information for the Approval History of the Adjustment until it is Frozen

CI_AUDIT.designer_notes: We can skip this since only a few tables have audit turned on. It's also not recommended to turn on auditing for many transaction tables at this time, as it would consume a lot of database space and may cause slowness on the server.

CI_BAL_CTL_GRP.designer_notes: We can skip this. The data being stored here which is the sum of Total and Current of FTs, are being processed by its background processes to check Integrity of the FTs in each historical Balance Control Group

CI_BILL_CHG.designer_notes: The CI_BILL_CHG table does not need to be designed since it functions as an internal/staging record. It will be picked up in the next bill, and the calculation line details will be reflected in CI_BSEG_CALC_LN. The Billable Charge ID will be linked to CI_BSEG_CALC.

CI_BUD_RVW.designer_notes: We can skip this. It’s mainly for C2M online use for users to easily view budget review records and directly navigate to the account.

CI_DEP_CTL_ST.designer_notes: We can skip this. This is a staging table for internal processing

CI_DEP_RVW.designer_notes: We can skip this. It’s mainly for C2M online use for users to easily view deposit review records and directly navigate to the account.

CI_ENRL.designer_notes: The order is being used by College Station to start a service, which is the object created by OCX during move-in. The end result is that the customer will have their SA started at the premise being moved into. We can skip this.

CI_PAY_TNDR_ST.designer_notes: We can skip this. This is a staging table for internal processing

CI_SA_REL.designer_notes:
We can skip this. The purpose of the SA Relationship is to record information if we handle the Billing of an External Server Provider (We Bill for Them) or it's us (the current utility provider). 

Currently, only City Corp is using this table, but only billing the currently utility, not an external

CI_SP.designer_notes: We can skip this, the SP information in C2M is retrieved from the D1_SP table.

CI_VAL_ERR.designer_notes: We can skip this. This is for Data Conversion use.

D1_COMM_IN.designer_notes: The stored data consists of CLOB data and is used in integration processes. We can skip this.

D1_COMM_OUT.designer_notes: The stored data consists of CLOB data and is used in integration processes. We can skip this.

D1_COMPL_EVT.designer_notes: The content is more technical than functional. Tables stores the Event Processes of an Activity. This can be skipped

D1_CONTACT.designer_notes: We can skip this. This is the equivalent of the Person Contact and IDs table in CCB which are viewable online on Person Page.

D1_INIT_MSRMT_DATA.designer_notes: This is handled on the Usage Exception and VEE exception

D1_SP_VEE_EXCP_SNAP_DL.designer_notes: We are not using this. This is specifically for Oracle Utilities Analytics and BI-Oriented Configurations.

D1_USAGE_EXCP.designer_notes: This is a child object of D1_USAGE, and it’s not typical exception data. It has its own Business Object and can be viewed online. This is  covered under D1_USAGE.

D1_VEE_EXCP.designer_notes: This is a child object of D1_INIT_MSRMT_DATA, and it’s not typical exception data. It has its own Business Object and can be viewed online. This is  covered under D1_INIT_MSRMT_DATA.
